Hi Olivia —

Great to meet last week. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that aligns the POC acceptance gates, pilot credits, and conversion triggers with proposed pricing/commit bands. High-level approach:

- 4-week POC (technical acceptance at week 3) with 100k token pilot credit applied up front.
- If acceptance criteria met in Week 3, a second tranche of 50k credit is released and we start a 30-day ramp window.
- Conversion to paid tier is triggered by either throughput (>=50 qps sustained) or a signed PO within 45 days of acceptance.
- Pricing ladder: 0-1M tokens/month — list price, 1-5M — 15% discount, 5M+ — 25% discount (committed).

Two items we want to confirm from your side: (1) procurement timing for a PO if the POC is successful, and (2) whether Acme needs credit carry-forward beyond the ramp window for evaluation of production load.

I've attached MAP-v1.xlsx with milestone checkboxes and the acceptance criteria we agreed on. Rishi — I pulled the pricing bands into the MAP; can you confirm we can offer the initial 15% anchor on a 6-month commit?

Olivia — if you want, we can present a short one-page executive summary for your leadership to accelerate procurement decisions.

Thanks,

Hi Olivia — quick answers inline: 

- Credit carry-forward: We can allow unused pilot credit to apply to month 1 of paid consumption if conversion is executed within 60 days of acceptance. We will cap carry-forward at 50% of the pilot credit (so for a 100k pilot credit, max 50k can be carried to month 1).

- Commit ladder and discounts: For a 6-month committed ramp we can confirm the 15% discount at 1-5M and 25% at 5M+. For a 9-month commit we can offer a sweeter anchor: 18% at 1-5M and 28% at 5M+ (requires 60% of expected monthly usage committed up front).

- Operational items: Daily audit exports for POC are fine — Dev, please ensure export hook and retention config in the MAP.

Proposed revision to MAP: add explicit PO milestone (Procurement signed) and a soft pass/fail on SLA checklist. If PO is delayed beyond 45 days post-acceptance, we automatically convert to a 30-day evaluation extension (no additional credits) and review conversion options.

Attached: pricing-sheet.csv with the bands and an example cost calc for your estimated 2.5M token month.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 212-555-0102
